2608.14191.title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding
2608.14191.paper_summary: The key-value (KV) cache stores information from past tokens and is a major memory bottleneck in long-context inference. Existing quantization methods address this bottleneck by representing the KV cache uniformly with lower-precision data types and designing quantization schemes to minimize reconstruction error in the cache itself, without accounting for how that error propagates through attention mechanisms. We prove that, under a white-noise quantization model, the expected attention-aware distortion decomposes into additive key and value contributions that factor across tokens and channels. Building on transform coding and reverse water-filling, which are classical tools from signal processing and rate-distortion theory, we introduce Attention-Aware Transform Coding (AATC), which allocates bits over a calibration set to minimize attention-aware distortion. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, evaluated across LongBench, RULER, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, and MATH-500, our method achieves near-lossless accuracy at approximately $5.8\times$ compression, whereas each baseline degrades in at least some settings.
2608.14191.paper_summary_zh: 關鍵值 (KV) 快取儲存來自過去標記的信息，是長上下文推理中的主要記憶瓶頸。現有的量化方法通過以較低精度數據類型均勻表示 KV 快取，並設計量化方案以最小化快取本身的重建誤差來解決這一瓶頸，而未考慮該誤差如何通過注意力機制傳播。我們證明，在白噪聲量化模型下，期望的注意力感知失真分解為可加的鍵和值貢獻，這些貢獻在標記和通道之間進行因式分解。基於變換編碼和反向水填充，這些是來自信號處理和速率失真理論的經典工具，我們引入了注意力感知變換編碼 (AATC)，它在校準集上分配位元以最小化注意力感知失真。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 上，通過 LongBench、RULER、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro 和 MATH-500 進行評估，我們的方法在約 $5.8\times$ 壓縮下達到了近無損的準確性，而每個基線在至少某些設置中都有所下降。
